verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is itself a documented public API. It exposes OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints reached via a base URL, a JSON models endpoint listing pricing and capabilities, API-key or OIDC authentication, and per-request `providerOptions.gateway` controls for routing, caching and BYOK. A probe also confirmed Vercel publishes an OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: evidence that management operations (budgets, logs, key management) can be driven by API rather than only the dashboard, and independent hands-on corroboration of the gateway endpoints themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: AI Gateway provides OpenAI Chat Completions API endpoints, letting you use multiple AI providers through a familiar interface.
Query the models endpoint directly to get a JSON list of all available models with pricing and capabilities
Every request to AI Gateway requires Vercel authentication. Use an AI Gateway API key or OpenID Connect (OIDC) token.
AI Gateway API keys belong to a Vercel team and work in local development, CI, external servers, and Vercel deployments.
You can use `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.
